issues.description: The problem statement for Aufgabe 01 requires outputting the ID, Name, Art and URL of all Freibäder, but the provided solution query does not include the ID column. This mismatch between the specification and the solution will confuse students about which columns are required and cause automated checks to disagree with the textual requirement.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the solution (and optionally the template) so the SELECT includes the ID column as required by the problem statement. For example: SELECT id, name, art, url FROM Schwimmbad WHERE art='Freibad'; Alternatively, if the ID was not intended to be required, adjust the problem statement to remove the ID from the requested columns so it matches the solution.
